data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays LLM cost over time with a line chart.
Stage completion rates are shown with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
features.description: Develop an 8-stage pipeline visualization using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline is accurately represented in 8 stages.
Each stage is visually distinct and labeled.
Chart is interactive and responsive.

features.title: Results Display
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent runs using actual data.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are up-to-date and accurate.
Data is displayed in a clear and informative manner.
Charts reflect actual performance results.

features.title: Code Quality Visualization
features.description: Visualize TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart accurately represents code quality metrics.
TDD compliance and SOLID principles are clearly displayed.
Chart is interactive and easy to interpret.

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize various data metrics in the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed with charts.
Charts include animations and interactive elements.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML file for the Artemis demo with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Apply a professional gradient background and smooth transitions to the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is visually appealing and consistent.
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional.
Design aligns with the branding of Artemis.

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Integration across stages is clearly visualized.
Pie chart is accurate and easy to understand.
Chart is interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: HERO Section Development
features.description: Create the HERO section to introduce Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: HERO section clearly explains Artemis's capabilities.
Design is engaging and captures user attention.
Content is concise and informative.
